new_items_introduced: Diadem of Songs (New Tear-based enchanter item)
Sundered Sky (Bruiser AD/HP/Crits and heals on first auto)
Terminus (ADC On-hit/Hybrid Pen/Armor and MR stacking)
Imperial Mandate (Reworked for support synergy in Patch 26.13)
objective_spawn_rules: Jungle Camps: Buffs, Wolves, Raptors spawn at 55 seconds (previously 1:30). Krugs/Gromp spawn at 1:07. First gank window is 2:55 - 3:10.
Dragon: First spawn at 5:00. Respawns every 5 minutes. Elder Dragon spawns 6 minutes after a team gets Dragon Soul.
Void Grubs: Spawns exactly ONCE per game at 8:00 (camp of 3 grubs, does NOT respawn, despawns at 13:45). Contesting grubs is highly valuable for top/jg.
Rift Herald: Spawns exactly ONCE per game at 15:00 (despawns at 19:30). Can be ridden to charge towers.
Atakhan: REMOVED in Season 2026. No longer spawns.
Baron Nashor: Spawns at 20:00. Respawns 6 minutes after being killed. Pit terrain changes depending on the Baron variant.
role_quests_system: Season 16 introduced unique Role Quests based on queue position:
Top Lane: Gains Teleport access, increased experience, and a higher level cap (Level 20).
Mid Lane: Receives free boot upgrades and Empowered Recalls.
Jungle: Focuses on jungle pet evolution and camp clearing speed benefits.
Bot/ADC: Receives items/boosts to scale damage in early skirmishes.
Support: Quest lines yield warding items and vision tools like Faelights.
champion_reworks: Skarner was completely reworked: vanguard tank. Q throws debris/rocks, W is an AOE shockwave slow, E charges through walls grabbing enemies, R is a skillshot impaling up to 3 targets.
Aurelion Sol was completely reworked: scaling late-game mage. Q is channeled breath, W is flying, E is a gravity black hole, R is a comet.
Smolder: scaling AD caster who stacks his passive to gain execution burn on his abilities.
Ambessa: high-mobility fighter who dashes on every ability cast.
Mel (New Champion, released Jan 23, 2025): Chem-baroness mage controlling battlefield zones with Chemtech magic.
Yunara (New Champion, released July 16, 2025): Wind/storm skirmisher with high mobility combos.
Zaahen (New Champion, released Nov 19, 2025): Durability-scaling top lane bruiser with heavy crowd control.
Shyvana VGU (completely reworked in March 2026 / Patch 26.05): Modernized dragon warrior with skillshot-based abilities, updated passive, and enhanced dragon form transformation.

Locke (New Champion, released June 24, 2026 / Patch 26.13): High burst mid-lane assassin. Passive: Silver Stake (bonus magic damage scaling with target missing health). Q: Ritual Nails (soul nails that mark enemies). W: Soul Ignition (attack/move speed with self-damage and end-heal). E: Ashen Pursuit (teleport + dash attack). R: Purgatory.
general_notes: The Mythic item system was removed. All items are Legendary, Epic, or Basic.

Be extremely precise with timing. If an objective is spawning soon, use the exact time remaining provided in the prompt (e.g., 'spawning in 5 seconds' or 'alive now'), do not make up or approximate timings.
Never suggest buying or building removed items or mythics.
Atakhan is REMOVED in Season 2026. Never reference Atakhan as an objective.
Always assume Void Grubs spawn at 8:00 only once, and Rift Herald at 15:00 only once.
Dragon spawns at 5:00 and respawns every 5 minutes. Baron spawns at 20:00 and respawns 6 minutes after kill.
